title: The boundary of a dilation is the dilation of the boundary
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and η := dilation a λ. Let X, X' ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ (m + 1)) satisfy X'(ω) = λ^{−(m+1)}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. Then ∂X'(ω) = λ^{−m}∂X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y, where ∂Y(φ) = Y(dφ) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ (m + 1) * X ω') → ∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X'.boundary ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X.boundary ω'
